The following are the statistics of the '''[[Süper Lig|Turkish First Football League]]''' in season 1983/1984.

==Overview==
Eighteen teams participated, and [[Trabzonspor]] won the championship. Trabzonspor would not win another league title until the [[2021–22 Süper Lig|2021–22]] season. This season was the first season in which no İzmir team took part in the league.
